initial_failure: Four private-database cases returned accepted/not_found despite a durable stop before the execution record was visible.
fix: Pending outcome lookup prioritizes the scoped durable stop over approval and missing-request states. Return nonterminal stopping with stop_requested=true; retain original-request polling and let late execution evidence take precedence.
coverage: real durable stop with and without recorded approval
late cancelled/completed execution records retain their actual outcome
frontend continues GET recovery without replay
existing durable dispatch controls and descendant contracts
checks: Ruff lint/format, ESLint and diff checks pass.
limits: This improves stop visibility before a run is available. It does not establish terminal cancellation from missing evidence, recover a crashed pre-execution admission, or impose the outstanding general recovery deadline. Frontend branch is unit-tested, not separately browser-tested. No production deployment or full acceptance claim.
